children.name: Tonoscolex indicus Julka, 1981
children.description: Brief Description (after Julka 1981) Length 162 – 207 mm, width 4 – 5 mm. Segments 176 – 383. Prostomium prolobous or pro-epilobous. First dorsal pore in intersegmental furrow 10 / 11 or 11 / 12. Setae lumbricine, setal formula aa = 1.43 – 1.83 ab = 0.75 – 0. 92 bc = 1.10 – 1.12 cd = 0.11 – 0.15 dd (before clitellum) and aa = 2.25 – 2.60 ab = 1.13 – 1.62 bc = 1.50 – 1.86 cd = 0.12 – 0.15 dd (postclitellar segments). Clitellum annular, on segments 13 – 15, setae present, dorsal pores absent. Spermathecal pores two pairs in 6 / 7 and 7 / 8 at a setal line. Male genital region extends across post setal of segment 16 and presetal of segment 18. Male pores in segment 17 at ab or b setal line, connected with deep transverse depression. Seminal grooves straight, with bent at both the ends, nearly E shaped. Female pores paired, minute, slight median to a line on segment 13. Septa 6 / 7 – 10 / 11 thickly muscular. Gizzard large in segment 6. Intestine begins in segment 14, typhlosole lamelliform, begin in segment 14 and end in segments 95 – 100. Calciferous glands stalked, three pairs in segments 10 – 12. Nephridia meroic, clustered nephridia associated with 5 / 6, exonephric micro-nephridia from segment 4 and posterior, enteronephric mega-nephridia in posterior segments only. Dorsal blood vessel single, extending anteriorly to the region of brain. Last pairs of hearts in segment 12.

children.name: Tonoscolex kabakensis Julka, 1981
children.description: Brief description (after Julka 1981) Length 175 – 210 mm, width 4 – 5 mm. Segments 304 – 419. Prostomium pro-epilobous. First dorsal pore in 9 / 10. Setae perichaetine, present on segment 2. Clitellum is annular, on segments 13 – 16, setae present, dorsal pores absent. Spermathecal pores two pairs in 6 / 7 and 7 / 8 at a setal line. Male genital region extends across 17 and anterior of segment 18, seminal grooves begin in segment 17 in b line and end at 17 / 18 in line with c. Male pores minute in segment 17, equatorial, 0.09 circumference apart. Female pores paired, minute, just anterior and median to a setal line. Septa 6 / 7 – 10 / 11 strongly muscular. Gizzard large in segment 6. Intestine begin segment 14, typhlosole simple, lamelliform, begin in segment 14 and ending in front of 90 – 95. Calciferous glands stalked, 5 pairs, in segments 8 – 12. Nephridia meroic, clustered nephridia near 5 / 6, v shaped exonephric micro nephridia in segment 4 and posteriorly, enteronephric meganephridia in posterior segments only. Dorsal blood vessel complete continue anterior to the brain, last pairs of hearts in segment 12. Testes and funnels in segment 9 and 10, seminal vesicles in segment 10 and 11. Prostate glands strap shaped, in segments 17 – 18, duct muscular, bent at its ental end and slightly thickened toward ectal end.

children.name: Tonoscolex kalimpongensis Ahmed & Julka, 2022
children.description: of holotype. Body cylindrical. Dimensions: body length 145 mm, width 5.5 mm at segment 8, 4.8 mm at 11 before clitellum, 5 mm at clitellum. Segments 266. Segments 1 – 4 consist of single annulus, segment 5 biannulate, segment 6 triannulate, segments 7 and 8 quadriannulate, segment 9 and onward triannulate up-to before segment 32 from the posterior end. Body colour light brown, clitellum reddish brown. Prostomium prolobous (Fig. 1 C). Setae lumbricine, present from segment 2, setal formula aa: ab: bc: cd: dd = 1.1: 0.4: 1.2: 0.5: 2.8 at segment 11 and aa: ab: bc: cd: dd = 1.1: 0.4: 1.3: 0.4: 3 at segment 22. First dorsal pore on intersegmental furrow 9 / 10, a pore like appears to be non-functional markings also present on 8 / 9 (Fig. 1 A). Clitellum annular extending from the posterior half of segment 12 to anterior half of segment 16 (i. e. covering post setal part of segment 12 and pre setal of segment 16), dorsal pores and setae present. Spermathecal pores one pair, in a transverse slit, slightly ventral to a setal lines, at intersegmental furrow 7 / 8 (Fig. 1 B). Female pores minute, paired, median to a in whitish transversely oval area, slightly anterior to the setal line on segment 13 (Fig. 1 B). Male pores on segment 17 at ab, and close to b setal lines. Male genital shield across segment 17 and anterior part of segment 18, narrower anteriorly than posteriorly, width of the genital shield on ventral 3 mm at segment 17 and 5 mm at segment 18 (Fig. 1 D).

children.name: Tonoscolex michaelseni Julka, 1976
children.description: Brief Description (after Julka 1976) Length, 158 – 390 mm, width 3 – 8 mm. Segments 280 – 390, segments 5 biannulate, 6 – 12 triannulate. Prostomium pro-epilobous. First dorsal pore, in intersegmental furrow 10 / 11. Setae, lumbricine, begin in segment 2; setal formula ab <cd <bc <aa. Clitellum 13 – ⅔ 16, setae present, dorsal pores occluded. Male genital shield extends across segment 17 and the posterior part of segment 16. Male pores large, on segment 17, at ab setal line. Seminal grooves straight, deep. Spermathecal pores two pairs in 6 / 7 and 7 / 8, slight median to a setal line. Septa, 6 / 7 – 9 / 10 thickened, 10 / 11 – 11 / 12, slightly thickened. Gizzard, elongated in segment 6. Intestinal origin in segment 14, typhlosole lamelliform, extends across 15 – 277, 296. Calciferous glands 4 pairs in segments 9 – 12. Nephridia meroic, cluster micro-nephridia in segment 6, enteronephric mega-nephridia along with exonephric micro-nephridia in posterior segments. Dorsal blood vessel continued anteriorly onto pharyngeal bulb. Last pairs of hearts in segment 12. Testes and funnels in segments 9 and 10, seminal vesicles in segments 10 and 11. Prostates strap shaped, extending across segments 16 – 18, prostatic duct looped near its origin, white, muscular, with a little shine. Spermathecal ampulla rounded, duct narrow toward ectal end, duct three times as long as ampulla; diverticulum club shaped, smaller than ampulla.

children.name: Tonoscolex oneili
children.description: Brief description (after Gates 1972) Length 105 – 185 mm, width 5 – 6 mm. Segments 230 – 244. Setae lumbricine. First dorsal pore in intersegmental furrow 10 / 11. Clitellum annular, extending on segments 13 – 16, dorsal pores absent, setae present. Prostomium prolobous. Spermathecal pores two pairs 6 / 7 and 7 / 8 and at a setal line. Female pores paired in setal zone, on segment 13, median to aa. Male pores on segment 17 at b setal line. Septa 6 / 7 – 10 / 11 thickened. Gizzard in segment 6. Intestine begins in segment 14. Calciferous glands 4 pairs in segments 9 – 12. Nephridia meroic, tuft nephridia on anterior face of 5 / 6, mega-nephridia along with micro-nephridia in posterior segments only. Last pairs of hearts in segment 12. Ovaries and funnels in segment 12. Testes and funnels in segments 9 and 10; seminal vesicles in segment 10 and 11. Prostates in segments 17 – 20, strap shaped. Spermathecal duct larger than ampulla, diverticulum club shaped.

children.description: Length 140 - 280 mm. Segments 200 - 440. Prolobic. Lumbricine. Dorsal pores from 11 / 12. Clitellum one-third 13 or 14 - 17. Spermathecal pores 4 pairs, minute, mid-ventrum, at 6 / 7 - 9 / 10. Male field slightly depressed on 18, with a pair of co mma-shaped lateral thickenings. Male pores minute in a depression between the lateral thickenings. Genital markings and seminal grooves absent. Gizzard single in 5. Intestinal origin in 15. Seminal vesicles in 12. Prostates in 18 - 19. Octothecal.

children.name: Kanchuria sumerianus Julka, 1988
children.description: Length 77 - 162 mm. Segments 147 - 269. Prolobic. Lumbricine. Dorsal pores from 11 / 12. Spermathecal pores two pairs, large longitudinal slits, on posterior margins of 7 and 8. Clitellum 14 - 17. Genital markings single, median, transversely oval, on 18 / 19. Male field depressed on 18. Male pores minute, paired, on setal line of 18, at anterior ends of seminal grooves and slightly raised circular porophores. Female pore, minute, paired, antero-median in 14. Intestines from 15. Seminal vesicles in 12. Prostates in 18 - 21.

children.name: Kanchuria turaensis Julka, 1988
children.description: Length 273 - 335 mm. Segments 279 - 485. Prolobic. Lumbricine. Dorsal pores from 11 / 12. Spermathecal pores three pairs, minute, on anterior margins of 7, 8 and 9. clitellum 13 - 17 or 14 - 17. Genital marking paired, oval on 18 / 19. Male field with slightly depressed, central flattened area, and paired obliquely placed lateral depressions on 18. Male pores at anterior ends of seminal grooves. Seminal grooves paired, with posterior ends divergent, turning inwards before terminating in the central apertures of genital markings. Female pore minute, single and median in 14. Intestines from 15. Seminal vesicles in 12. Prostates in 18 - 19, 22.
